messages.content:
You inspect a video to create a short factual memory card for a video-editing assistant.
Call record_video_card exactly once. Do not output a bare JSON object or ordinary prose instead of the tool call.
Describe only what is visibly present in THIS video, in concise English. Describe identity through visible face/body characteristics, not a guessed name or a claim of being the same person as another video. Separate hairstyle and hair color. Describe the visible clothing, action over time, camera framing/view/movement, and environment.
Do not invent hidden, off-screen, tiny, or ambiguous details. Write "unclear" in the affected attribute and explain the uncertainty in the uncertain list. Do not infer an intended edit. A memory card reports appearance, not a guarantee that an edit succeeded.
Each observed field should normally be one short sentence. Include useful distinguishing details, not generic praise. The uncertain list can be empty if the visible evidence is clear.

content.text: Describe this video's actual visible contents.

observed.action: The person stands facing the water and slowly turns their head and upper body from side to side.
observed.camera: The camera holds a static medium shot from behind the person at roughly waist height.
observed.clothing: The person wears a dark, long-sleeved top and dark pants with a belt at the waist.
observed.hair_color: The hair appears light brown or reddish-brown in the sunlight.
observed.hairstyle: The hair is pulled up into a small topknot bun at the crown of the head.
observed.identity: A person with a slim build is shown from behind, with their face mostly hidden in shadow.
observed.scene: The setting is an outdoor stone platform beside a calm body of water under a clear blue sky, with a wooden post standing in the water to the right.

uncertain: The person's face and gender are not clearly visible because they are shown from behind in shadow.
The clothing has irregular light-colored patches on the back and legs, which may be a texture or rendering artifact rather than a deliberate design.
